tools.name: TubeBuddy

tools.evidence_summary: TubeBuddy's current official affiliate page closes the program to new applicants. Current official terms still document the legacy/active-affiliate 15% recurring economics and payout rules, but COSHUMA must not create a new application while signup is closed.

tools.name: OutlierKit
tools.commission: Recurring commissions on the first 12 payments from each referred customer; current public official page does not state the percentage
tools.payout_terms: Monthly payouts; no earnings cap stated on the official page
tools.eligibility: Official page offers a free affiliate account and a unique referral link through its partner portal
tools.evidence_summary: Current official OutlierKit page confirms a live free affiliate signup, recurring commissions on the first 12 payments, monthly payouts, no earnings cap and a real-time dashboard.
